title: WHICH ONCE MORE DEMONSTRATES THE USELESSNESS OF PASSPORTS AS AIDS TO DETECTIVES
summary_hover: Phileas Fogg and Passepartout visit the consul's office in Suez for a passport visa, unwittingly being scrutinized by Detective Fix.
summary_detail: Detective Fix rushes to the British consul at Suez to explain his suspicions about the bank robber. Shortly after, Phileas Fogg and Passepartout arrive to have Fogg's passport visaed. Although the consul sees nothing amiss, Fix is determined to investigate further. Fogg returns to his cabin on the Mongolia and methodically logs his travel time, noting he is exactly on schedule.
